read: 00:57..1:12:07 (all turns, Medi and Amal, including chat lines)
coverage_note: No holes. Most of the lesson is a translation drill: Amal gives an English sentence and Medi builds the Arabic (mufaddal, awal/aa5er, taani/8eir/kamaan, a8lab). Long English-only stretches at 33:08-34:28 (his sister Renad and plurals), 36:11-37:46 (type vs types), 52:46-53:33 (upload/assign homework) and 44:34-47:05 (he left the call). Engine echoes: 25:21 Amal 'ريف، باب سيت' = تاني، بتبسط; 31:33 Medi 'عادي نفس' = هادي نفس (Amal answered 'هذي or هادا؟'); 51:54/52:27/52:33 Amal 'ٱش ٱش' = حشيش; 06:16/06:34 Amal 'تشرب ليون' is probably a date question (تاريخ اليوم?), not clear; 06:59 Amal 'جدSA' ≈ الساعة؟; 07:55 Medi 'ألأ' = أقل (Levantine a2al, sound only, so not a row); 29:16 'قابة' = غابة (S4); 1:06:04/1:06:09 'أكلب' = أغلب (S4); 13:58 Amal 'شفياني هاي' and 14:03 'elbowss are then' are garbled; 1:10:34 Medi 'مع الشوق بك' is garbled. Left out on purpose: 04:20 نانا for نعنع (both ع dropped / Persian na'na, S4; Amal said 'نعنع طازة'); 03:46 فمي→بطني, his own fix at 03:50 before her 03:53 question; 04:39 Amal 'صارت أحسن؟' after his 'خطيبتي أحسن', which is already correct Arabic, so it is help, not a slip; 15:06 'عندي المفضل', which he fixed himself to 'المفضلين عندي' by asking; questions about rules with no attempt before them (40:00 'mukhtalif anwa?', 40:15 'النوع المختلف؟', 52:22 'حشاشيش؟', 48:56 'اكتبي؟'); 1:06:20 زغار→رخاص, his own fix at the same moment as her line; 59:05 'أخر سؤال إلي' and 1:00:52 are repeats of her fixes (GR-32). There is no laazem_noun case in this lesson.

rows.why: بوجع is the I-form (I hurt); the stomach is the subject, so it needs بيوجع(ني). Amal only asked 'Your mouth hurts?' and did not fix the verb (my reading).

rows.medi_said: أنا راح أطلب إلها / is it أطلب لها؟
rows.amal_said: You're gonna ask of her? or you're gonna order for her?
rows.why: To ask something of someone, اطلب takes من. Amal's question made him change to أطلب منها at 05:27, and she said ممتاز.
rows.english: I'm going to ask her (to buy mint).

rows.why: Days of the week take el- (her sheet: Yoam el-jum3a). Amal let it pass.

rows.wrong: عشرة، عـ- عشرة، عشـ-- عشر-- دقايق
rows.why: In clock time دقايق is dropped; when a noun is counted, ten is عشر, not عشرة. Amal let it pass.
In idafa the first word takes no el-, and he meant 'words' (plural). Amal recast it in two steps (كلمات, then كلمات الطبيعة at 08:42).

rows.amal_said: كلمات الطبيعة. ... لا، طبيعة just nature. Don't have plural of nature.
rows.why: He invented a plural for طبيعة. Amal recast it and said nature has no plural.
He gave قمر as a feminine word that sounds masculine; Amal said No. He said 'قمر is masculine' at the same moment, so it may be his own fix.
قارة ends in -a, so it is plainly feminine, not a hidden-gender noun. Amal gave أرض in its place.
He could not recall the masculine-but-sounds-feminine word, so Amal supplied it (a didn't-know).

rows.amal_said: شو كمان؟ شو بزيد؟ ... المفضل عندي.
rows.why: 'My favorite' on its own needs 3ind + the person. Amal prompted twice, he guessed wrong, and she gave المفضل عندي.
Before el-mufaddal the noun must be definite. Amal recast it with el- (البوظة الحلوة).

rows.amal_said: It's taking the tense of the noun ... (to 'would it be مفضلة؟') Mm-hmm.
rows.why: بوظة is feminine, so mufaddal must be مفضلة. Amal explained the rule and confirmed مفضلة, but said she had heard him say مفضلة.
He asked for the plural (offering the dual) and Amal supplied مسلسلات.

rows.medi_said: الـ مفضل. No. مفضل الـ. الـ مفضل الـ.
rows.why: Mufaddal is an adjective that follows its noun. Amal said No and he rebuilt it as بوظتي المفضلة.

rows.amal_said: No. This is my favorite ... on its own, so we use the new way. جبال means my mountains.
rows.why: 'Mountains are my favorite' takes el-noun + el-mufaddal + 3indi, not a possessive. Amal said No and explained.
Asked for 'one mountain', he gave the plural. Amal recast it as جبل.

rows.amal_said: Wow, you remember many words. So beach is
rows.why: He used the MSA شاطئ. Amal asked 'So beach is' and he gave her word شط (sheet: beach | Sha66 | شط). This may just have been a quiz.

rows.medi_said: So بحيرة تاني. ... So بحيرة التانية.
rows.amal_said: The other lake. ... We corrected this fact. ... البحيرة الثانية.
rows.why: 'The other' is el-noun el-taanie, feminine to match بحيرة. Amal prompted, then recast at 23:32.
شط/شاطئ is masculine, so it takes هذا. Amal recast and he repeated هذا الشاطئ.
He asked for the word. He then misheard it as غادة twice until she said 'B as in boy'.

rows.amal_said: Yes، بس غابة is what؟ ... It is so واحد أو واحدة.
rows.why: غابة is feminine, so 'one' must be واحدة. Amal prompted on the gender and he fixed it.
rows.english: This forest is the first one.

rows.medi_said: أنا بروح أو أنا بروحها. ... أنا بروحها?
rows.amal_said: أنا بروح to. ... بروح عليها. I go to.
rows.why: روح takes على, not an object ending. Amal prompted and then gave بروح عليها.

rows.medi_said: Does it have to do with "بختر" or no?
rows.amal_said: It has to do with مفضل.
rows.why: He guessed the root of 'choose' for 'prefer' as a question, and Amal pointed him to مفضل/بفضل.

rows.chat: hada nafs el-manzar illi shufto fi Madrid
rows.why: The engine wrote عادي; he said هادي (feminine) for masculine منظر. Amal asked 'هذي or هادا؟' and he chose هذا.

rows.medi_said: I saw in Madrid. ش-- اه،
rows.chat: hada nafs el-manzar illi shufto fi Madrid
rows.why: He started the verb without illi. Amal stressed 'That I saw' and he added اللي.

rows.amal_said: No. It's the M group ... مناظر.
rows.why: Broken plural pattern. Amal said No, pointed to the M group, and gave مناظر.

rows.amal_said: I brought to you. ... جبت لك.
rows.why: جبتك means 'I brought you'; the receiver goes on la-. Amal corrected him in English, then confirmed جبت لك.
8eir is followed by a bare noun and never by el-. Amal recast it as غير نوع.

rows.proposed_rule: In 'a type of X', نوع stays singular and the plural sits on X with min: غير نوع من الشجر.
rows.why: He put the plural on نوع. Amal said the plural is on شجر and he went back to نوع, but she had earlier said a plural type was also possible, so this is unclear.
The target was 'my day', which needs the possessive ending. Amal prompted in English and he gave يومي.
rows.english: Since the beginning of my day.

rows.why: After min, food in general keeps el- (min el-akel). Amal recast it as الأكل.

rows.medi_said: أنا جربت أنواع أنواع مختلف الأكل.
rows.chat: ana jarrabet anwaa3 mu5talefeen min el-akel
rows.why: من is missing between the adjective and the food. Amal recast it, then at 47:15 asked 'Where's the من؟'.
rows.english: I tried different types of food.

rows.why: He used the bare أكل again after her 45:27 fix, and she fixed it again, so it counts as its own slip (GR-32).

rows.medi_said: أعطيني ثلاث، ثلاث ورقة، ثلاث ورقة.
rows.why: The numbers 3-10 take a plural noun. Amal's voiced fix is garbled ('تلاتة add'); her chat shows ورقات.

rows.medi_said: أنا بحتاج uh, غير الـ ورقة.
rows.amal_said: ال never غير، غير never ends.
rows.why: Amal named the rule (no el- with 8eir) and he fixed it to غير ورقة.
Kamaan meaning 'another' goes before the noun. Amal pushed and he said كمان ورقة; she then confirmed the rule.
Houses don't 'have' grass; it is 'in them' (fi). Amal prompted in English and he said فيهم.
rows.english: Most houses in America have grass.

rows.medi_said: آخر سؤالي ... Would it be سؤالي آخر إلي؟
rows.amal_said: What would it means? ... No? ... سؤالي الأخير. Or آخر سؤال إلي.
rows.why: aa5er + a possessive noun means 'the end of my...'. Amal asked what it meant, rejected his second try, and gave both right forms.

rows.chat: haadi lu3beti el-oola / awal lu3be ili
rows.why: Feminine لعبة keeps its -t before the ending. After her recast he also changed to هذه and الأولى.

rows.medi_said: أول لعبة على ثنتين، على اثنتين
rows.why: Clock time takes el- (3ala el-tentain). Amal only typed it and said 'very good' out loud, so per GR-19 this is a let-pass.
rows.english: The first game is at two.

rows.why: 'The other game' needs el- on both words. Amal said Mm-mm and recast it.
The target was 'more enjoyable' and he said 'better', a different word. Amal prompted in English and he built بتبسط أكتر.
rows.english: The other game is more fun.

rows.why: He put أكتر before the verb. Amal recast the order, and he stated 'أكتر always goes after'.
لعبة has a broken plural. Amal supplied ألعاب.
He used the wrong plural again right after her fix, and she fixed it again (GR-32: its own slip). أكلب = أغلب is S4.

rows.amal_said: آخر لعبتي means the end of my games.
rows.why: aa5er + a possessive means 'the end of'. Amal named the meaning.
After the noun the adjective is a5eera (feminine), not آخر. Amal pointed at the gender and he said الأخيرة.

rows.amal_said: No, آخر اللعبة means end of.
rows.why: aa5er + el- means 'the end of'. Amal said No and he fixed it to آخر لعبة إلي.

rows.amal_said: كان and آخر. So كان بيزهى. ... I'm describing آخر as was boring.
rows.why: The subject is آخر (masculine), not لعبة. Amal named the rule and gave كان بيزهّق.
rows.english: The end of the game was boring.
